correctness.rationale: For all n≥3 and t>0, positive definiteness of L+J/(2n), strict convexity of tr(L+J/(2n))^{-1} on connected Laplacians, and injectivity from individual edge conductances prove existence and uniqueness of a global minimizer, not merely a two-class candidate. The graph/price symmetries force matching conductance a and off-matching b. Exact nonzero spectrum is 2(a+(n−1)b), nb (n−1 times), and 2a+(n−2)b (n−1 times). The cost n t a+n(n−1)b=1 and x=a/b yield the stated F=(tx+n−1)H. Computing the endpoint derivative proves deletion iff t≥n²(4n²−11n+8)/[(n−2)(4n³−11n²+10n−4)], equality included, with a unique interior minimizer otherwise. Symbolic expansion confirms T_n=1+2/n+7/(2n²)+O(n^-3) and for t_n=1+s/n, nF′ converges locally to 2s+4x−4 yielding x→(1−s/2)_+. The fixed-t asymptotics have separate coercivity/minimizer-control arguments. Independently recomputed symbolic signs and 36 exact rational Laplacian inversions; these bounded checks are ancillary.
